text_block_list.text:
The day of the Arima Kinen has finally
arrived.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
While things are heating up between
Triple Crown
champion Нарита Брайан and
the "Queen of the
Amazons" Hishi
Amazon...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган determinedly heads to
the track
with no intention of losing to
either of them.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
